label: Gearbox bearing overheating
description: Bearing temperature above its alarm limit; often a symptom of wear or poor lubrication

label: Gearbox bearing wear
description: Progressive mechanical wear of a gearbox bearing

label: Gearbox lubrication fault
description: Insufficient oil pressure or flow in the gearbox lubrication circuit

label: Gear oil contamination
description: Particles or debris in the gear oil; can indicate gear or bearing wear

label: Generator cooling fault
description: Generator cooling fan overload or failure
